VADER for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC): an orbit-based vector synth. Three zips: `VADER-<version>-mpc-sdk.zip` for MPC OS 3.10.1 or later (any MPC or Force, no mod: turn on External Plugin Support and copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins`); `VADER-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` for the 32-bit MPCs and the Force and `VADER-<version>-mpc-aarch64.zip` for the 64-bit MPCs (Live III, XL, One G2, Key G2), both for the Open MPC Plugin Manager or by hand with INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
All hold the plugin with example shapes and samples. How to use it: [the user guide](https://github.com/sunskiefer/VADER/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then). See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.

**0.10.4** makes the envelope per corner: with CORNER SELECT on A, B, C or D the ATTACK / DECAY / SUSTAIN / RELEASE lines are that corner's own envelope, on ALL they move every corner together as before; older saves load with their envelope on all four corners. **0.10.3** gives each corner's SAMPLE a dropdown list with a scrollbar (data wheel, touch or mouse) and makes the desktop window pure black. **0.10.2** made each corner's sample MODE the switch: OFF plays only the corner's voice, ONE SHOT or a LOOP plays only the sample (silence while it loads or when the file is not found, never the voice); MODE starts OFF. Otherwise 0.10.1: the 64-bit build for the newer MPCs and Akai's plugin format, packaged the way the Open MPC catalog reads it; the sound, pages, PLUG (the desktop plugin as the MPC's screen) and the companion screen are 0.9.2's. It has not been tried on a device yet (0.9.1 was tried on the Force). PolyForm Noncommercial license. The desktop plugins (VST3 and VST2 for Windows and Linux) are in the `desktop-0.10.4` release.
